review_type: Read-only code review following requesting-code-review; not a blind review and not evidence of student-independent implementation

strengths.details: Answer tokens are appended to an exact multimodal prompt prefix; EOS is included; prompt labels are masked with -100. sequence_logprob uses causal shift and a sum over supervised tokens.

DPO uses -logsigmoid(beta*((policy_chosen-ref_chosen)-(policy_rejected-ref_rejected))). The reference is the same frozen NF4 base with adapters disabled, in eval mode and under no_grad; cached reference scalars are detached.
DPO starts from a fresh base plus one saved SFT adapter wrapper. Language-only q/k/v/o adapter targets exclude vision. Exact requested steps are completed and adapters are saved afterward.

NF4 baseline matches the prepared base used during training; BF16 baseline is separately labeled. Each DPO variant starts in a fresh process from the same SFT checkpoint, with the same seed and hyperparameters except the intended pair pool/beta.

12 original and 5 added preference pairs match declared image facts and document their failure modes. Predictions, old/new scoring, training traces, masks, source hash and SFT parent hash are retained. Resubstitution evaluation is explicitly identified.

resolved_findings.issue: All modes defaulted to results/baseline, causing normal infer->sft execution to refuse a completed baseline output and preventing default dpo from finding a default SFT adapter.
resolved_findings.resolution: Mode-dependent output defaults are now selected after argparse; new CLI behavior test passes.

resolved_findings.issue: Parent log/results paths and child model/output paths used different current directories when launched outside lab05.
resolved_findings.resolution: Model and results resolve against script root and are passed as absolute paths; data is also absolute.

resolved_findings.issue: Single-character Chinese number matching counted 十二个/十三个/十四个 as 2/3/4.
resolved_findings.resolution: Full Chinese numeral tokens are parsed; 12/22 and unsupported 102 do not match a gold 2. Expanded tests pass.

resolved_findings.issue: English descriptive affirmative answers were not recognized and unrelated negatives could falsely match existence questions.
resolved_findings.resolution: English affirmative patterns and queried-object guards have been added, with focused regression cases. Multi-clause scope remains a limitation as recorded below.

findings.title: Existence scoring still treats any negative clause as a negative answer to the queried object

reproduction.prediction: There is a red circle, but no blue squares.

findings.impact: The sentence explicitly asserts the queried red circle exists, so it is wrong for P12. The unrelated no blue squares clause currently makes it count as correct. Automatic existence totals can therefore be inflated by fluent multi-clause model output.
findings.recommendation: Before writing final report totals, audit all raw existence outputs against the query and preserve any corrections alongside the original automatic score. If improving automation, bind negation to the clause describing the queried object or conservatively mark multi-clause ambiguous outputs for manual review, and add this regression case. This does not block formal training.
